whatsappMessage:
Hi Team New Hungry Hope,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.4★ reviews near Danapur Station in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online food orders and table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur popular dishes ki gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://new-hungry-hope-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team New Hungry Hope, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (New Hungry Hope) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, and a showcase of your top dishes right near Danapur Station. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, prices aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
